thesis: Camtek Ltd. (Nasdaq: CAMT; also TASE), Israeli inspection and metrology equipment for advanced packaging and HBM; files 20-F and 6-K, US GAAP in USD. Q3 2026 (6-K filed 2026-11-04): revenue 161.3M (+28% vs 126.0M), GAAP gross margin 50.0%, GAAP net income 42.8M (EPS 0.84 diluted; non-GAAP 0.99) vs a 53.2M net loss in Q3 2025, OCF 71.1M (Q2 was only 12.2M, so lumpy). Cash, deposits and securities 877.1M; convertible notes 489.2M, so net cash about 388M. Guidance: Q4 revenue about 180M (+40%), 2026 about 595M, 2027 above 800M (+35%), management says it has a year of visibility. At 101.73 (2026-11-13 close, -3.5%, 52-week 89.13-215.99, about 53% below the high) and 46.73M shares (stockanalysis; point-in-time count unread), market cap about 4.75B, EV about 4.36B, EV/TTM revenue 8.0x (544.3M), EV/2026 guide 7.3x, EV/2027 guide 5.4x. Trailing GAAP P/E 38.4x and forward 20.5x per stockanalysis (unverified forward). FCF cannot be computed because capex was not read; it is missing, not zero. Market view: the fall from about 216 likely prices an AI packaging capex cycle peak and a weak H1 (Q2 revenue +8%); the evidence that differs is the guided second-half and 2027 acceleration, but that is management guidance, unverified by orders.
counterthesis: Guidance is management's own and a customer-concentrated, cyclical industry can reverse; H1 2026 growth was only about 8% so the stock may be right to doubt the ramp. Q3 2025 had a 53.2M GAAP loss (cause unread, probably convertible or FX revaluation), so GAAP earnings swing on non-operating items and TTM P/E is unreliable. Quarterly OCF is lumpy (12.2M vs 71.1M). Convertible notes 489M are a dilution and refinancing claim. Export controls, China exposure and customer concentration (largest customers and backlog not read) are unreviewed. Foreign private issuer, so disclosure is semi-annual style plus 6-Ks; the 20-F was not read. SEC XBRL on file shows only FY2025 revenue 496.1M, net income 50.7M, OCF 141.9M.
invalidation: Thesis fails if Q4 revenue falls short of about 180M, 2027 visibility weakens, gross margin falls below about 47%, or key customers cut advanced packaging inspection orders.
